subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should maintainers accept the focused terminal liveness proof for this bootstrap-context scheduling change, or require a live embedded_run smoke before merge?
rationale: The patch has no concrete source-level defect from this review, but it changes bootstrap file resolution and bootstrap hook scheduling where CI cannot fully prove upgrade behavior or live channel responsiveness.

options.title: Require exact-head embedded_run smoke
options.body: Run a maintainer/Testbox or Crabbox scenario that exercises embedded_run bootstrap context with a broad extra-bootstrap glob and at least one bootstrap hook before merge.

options.title: Accept focused proof and CI
options.body: Treat the PR body terminal proof plus the passing exact-head checks and focused regression tests as sufficient because no public SDK or config surface changes.

options.title: Pause for narrower replacement
options.body: If a custom full-tree walker is too risky for upgrades, pause this branch and ask for a smaller maintainer-directed implementation.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head embedded_run smoke
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer/Testbox or Crabbox scenario that exercises embedded_run bootstrap context with a broad extra-bootstrap glob and at least one bootstrap hook before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest historical connection to the bootstrap, embedded runtime, and internal hook surfaces affected by the maintainer choice.
